title: Rebalance Patch
summary:
Rebalance Patch

● Rank Mode opens up now
● Muerta: $2 instead of $3, and adjusted accordingly
● Pudge: $3 instead of $2,and adjusted accordingly
● Frenzy(Talent 3A): Lifesteal percentage increased from 20% to 25%
● (Keep up with Dota2) Pure Damage cannot have lifesteal.
● Due to Dota2 Precache problems, all Arcana decorations are removed to ensure loading stability. We made our best effort to redecorate all the chess pieces with nice looks.
● Now Relic will be shown in item slots due to Dota2 New Mechanism.

Click the title link to check the full update details!
